description: Choose what to collect from Google Play: search results, app details, reviews, developer catalogs, similar apps, permissions, or data safety.

appIds.description: Package names or Google Play URLs. Used by details, reviews, similar, permissions, and dataSafety modes.
appIds.title: App IDs

country.description: Storefront for search results, pricing, and availability. Reviews are selected by Language, not Country.
country.title: Country

developerId.description: Numeric Google Play developer ID or a developer page URL, used in mode=developer.
developerId.title: Developer ID

developerName.description: Display name shown on Google Play, for example `Google LLC`, used in mode=developer.
developerName.title: Developer name

includeDataSafety.description: Add shared data, collected data, security practices, and the privacy policy URL to app records.
includeDataSafety.title: Include data safety

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full app page for search and developer results, and include app metadata in permissions/dataSafety output. Adds one request per app.
includeDetails.title: Include full app details

includePermissions.description: Add the app's permission list to app records. Works in search, details, developer, and similar modes.
includePermissions.title: Include permissions

language.description: Language for app pages and the review bucket. Google Play uses this language, not Country, to choose reviews.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows. Search returns at most 250 apps per query. For similar mode one seed app is one row.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Reviews to collect for each app. Google Play returns at most 4,500 reviews per page; the actor paginates up to this cap.
maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app

enumTitles: App details by package name or URL
mode.title: Mode

packageNames.description: Android package names such as `com.whatsapp`. Play URLs are also accepted.
packageNames.title: Package names

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy; use one only if Google Play blocks your runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for in mode=search, for example `photo editor` or `calculator`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

startUrls.description: Full Google Play app URLs, for example `https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.whatsapp`.
startUrls.title: Google Play app URLs

title: Google Play Store Scraper Input
